item_001.one_line_why: RDKit confirms the identical 42-atom molecule and stereochemistry; the rationale proposes no actual edit and cites no contacts.

item_002.one_line_why: The edit is biphenyl to naphthalene, not benzophenone replacement (41 to 39 atoms); PHE97/TYR101 carbon contacts exist, but their ownership by the edited rings cannot be settled from this table.

item_003.one_line_why: N-methyl becomes N-phenyl (+5 atoms), with the other groups retained; LEU156 contacts belong to C28/N17 and ILE56 to C32, but their ownership by the edited N-methyl region cannot be established; MET108 N19/N26 and LYS114 O23 H-bond rows are real.

item_004.one_line_why: The 18-atom sugar is unchanged and contains no F; C12 really faces TYR375.OH at 3.41 A, but that row is polar/apolar packing and supports neither the claimed replacement nor enhanced hydrophobic binding.

item_005.one_line_why: RDKit confirms the identical 25-atom molecule; the repetitive rationale identifies no edit or binding-site consequence and cites no contacts.

item_006.one_line_why: The 31-atom molecule is unchanged; no edit or specific contact is explained, and the retained aryl S(=O)2CCO group is a sulfone rather than the stated sulfonate.

item_007.one_line_why: Only Cl becomes F, preserving rings and imine stereochemistry; the unique CL29 owns the GLY96.O contact at 3.44 A, but this packing row does not establish the asserted steric clash or guaranteed closer binding.

item_008.one_line_why: The proposal retains every parent atom including sulfamate N3S and adds a six-atom hydroxythietanone ether with two stereocentres; the real N3S-TYR43.CD2 packing row therefore does not support the claimed N-to-C replacement or disruption.

item_009.one_line_why: RDKit confirms the identical 39-atom molecule and stereocentre, including the retained Cl; the claimed Cl-to-OH substitution never occurs, and no protein contacts are cited.

item_010.one_line_why: Both amide nitrogens and the entire 27-atom molecule are retained; N2 really hydrogen-bonds to ASP164.OD2 at 2.90 A, but the proposal does not replace that donor or eliminate its bond.

item_011.one_line_why: The proposed 23-atom molecule exactly matches the input; the rationale supplies no structural edit or contact-based explanation.

item_012.one_line_why: The 22-atom molecule is unchanged, so no contact increase follows; PHE377.O (C15) and CYS393.SG (C21) rows are polar/apolar packing rather than the claimed hydrophobic contacts, while CL2-CYS320.O and O4-PHE388.CE1 packing rows are real.

item_013.one_line_why: Only Cl becomes Br; the unique chlorine CL2 faces GLN105.OE1 at 2.99 A, whereas GLU71 appears only as C31-GLU71.CD packing at 3.38 A, which cannot support a Br-Glu71 halogen bond.

item_014.one_line_why: The edit is sugar OH-to-O-phenyl (+6 atoms), retaining all methyl groups; C4-MET40.CB packing is real, but C4 is not established as the modified hydroxyl site or a methyl, so claimed contact ownership cannot be settled.

item_015.one_line_why: RDKit confirms only cyclopentyl-to-cyclohexyl expansion (+CH2), retaining stereochemistry; LEU391 contacts are C11/C12 and LEU483 is C14, but their assignment to that ring cannot be settled without ligand connectivity for the CCD labels.

item_016.one_line_why: The proposal retains tert-butyl and adds an aryl CH(cyclopropyl)CH(CH3)2 substituent (+7 atoms, one unspecified stereocentre), not methyl-to-cyclopropylmethyl replacement; real TRP331.CH2 contacts belong to C6/C7, whose mapping to the added site cannot be settled.
